text: On September 17, 2025, Etobicoke York Community Council adopted Item EY25.26 directing staff from Development Review, in consultation with CreateTO, to report to the October 21, 2025 Community Council meeting with information on 250 Wincott Drive and 4620 Eglinton Avenue West. This report provides the requested information.
City Council on November 12 and 13, 2025, received Item EY26.7 for information.
